blocks.text: SINGAPORE — Information and Communications Technology Secretary Henry Aguda will remain in his post amid reports that he had resigned, Malacañang said on Wednesday. Palace press officer Claire Castro said officials had just spoken with Aguda, who indicated that he would continue working as secretary of the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT). “Wala ring ganong impormasyon dahil kakausap pa lang natin kay Secretary Henry Aguda at nagbigay siya ng larawan din kay Secretary Dave Gomez na patuloy ang trabaho niya bilang sekretarya ng DICT,” Castro told reporters in Singapore.
